posts.title: Welcome to the board
posts.body: You do not know what someone is going through today. A simple 'I hope you're having a good day' can really make someone's day.

posts.title: Local food pantries always need hands
posts.body: Food pantries and banks are a great place to start if you're not sure where to volunteer — flexible hours, real impact, right in your community.
Kindness rarely takes more than a few seconds to give, but it can carry someone through an entire day.
posts.title: Worth the two seconds

posts.body: We went as a family and had a great time. It was so nice getting to meet the people who work hard to keep our community safe, and there were fun activities that got the kids out of the house and into the community for the day. Grateful for events like this,  more, please!
posts.title: Fill the Squad.  A great day for the whole family
